scope: Every remaining inventoried C target in the resident executable, 26 executable overlays, and auxiliary NTGUI2EU image. Explicit assembly-only exclusions retain their existing inventory policy.
limitations: Accepted means a complete compiling research draft passed relocation and structural checks; it does not establish semantic equivalence. No similarity floor applies. Failed and incomplete translations receive no source coverage.

status_definitions.accepted: Admitted to nonmatching/ after normal compiler and structural verification.
status_definitions.comparison_rejected: Compilation, length, relocation, symbol-address evidence, or external-transfer checks failed under all tested profiles.
status_definitions.normal_verification_rejected: Private screening passed, but authoritative normal-wrapper verification rejected the draft.
status_definitions.incomplete_translation: Translation contains unsupported instructions or unresolved register/translation placeholders.
status_definitions.static_rejected: Source checks rejected incomplete or unestablished storage/parameter constructs.
status_definitions.translation_failed: Translator did not produce a complete successful output.
status_definitions.translation_exception: Translator raised an exception or exceeded its per-function time limit.
status_definitions.unknown_tail_contract: External tail target argument/return contract is not established.
status_definitions.unknown_indirect_tail_contract: Indirect tail target and forwarding contract are not established.
